messages:
Anna R: Quick triage — we need a priority grid for the benchmark creative set + webinar hero. timeline: webinar Tue AM, need assets by Fri EOD PST.
Marcus L: Got it. Are we doing full benchmark tile set + 3 social cuts + webinar hero?
Anna R: Yes — full tile set (4 sizes), hero (desktop + mobile), 3 social cuts (16:9, 1:1, story). Also: 2 copy variants for each, and localized tiles for FR/DE/ES.
Jess K: tagging design capacity — @Maria G are you able to take the hero + social cuts? I can handle the tile layout and export specs.
Maria G: I can take hero + socials. ETA: first pass Wed noon. Need final approved copy and brand checklist (colors, icon set).
Patrick H: Marketing ops: we need export specs and routing info for inbound. FYI: QA wants 1200x628, 800x800, 1080x1920 and SVG for icons. Also send Figma link and a single arg for tracking (utm_campaign=bench-webinar-apr).
Jess K: Export spec snippet for design: ```
- hero_desktop: 1600x900 @2x (export PNG)
- hero_mobile: 900x1600 @2x
- social_16_9: 1200x675
- social_1_1: 1080x1080
- story: 1080x1920
- icons: SVG + PNG 64/128
```
Marcus L: Legal/brand check — can we avoid the phrase "lowest inference cost"; legal prefers "cost-efficient inference". Also confirm logo lockup and badge usage with brand v3.
Anna R: Noted. @Design Bot please attach brand v3 checklist and the approved logo pack.
Design Bot: Brand checklist attached. ticket #4823 updated. (auto)
Maria G: Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/benchmark-creative-pack — I've added frames for each variant and a localization tab. Please add translated copy directly into the layers.
Patrick H: Inbound routing: once assets live, add mapping to LP and GTM: tag=bench-apr24, route leads to webinar-list@hubspot, and create a lead source rule for "benchmark_webinar".
Jess K: Quick question — do we want a localized hero image or just translate overlay copy? Localized backgrounds cost more.
Anna R: For FR/DE only localized overlay + translated captions is fine. Full localized hero only if Maria flags it as quick.
Maria G: Can do overlays for FR/DE/ES. Will flag any layout issues by Wed morning.
Marcus L: For the benchmark tiles, include a small stats strip (latency, cost delta, quality note). Keep them subtle and legal-approved.
Anna R: I'll prepare the copy grid with two tone variants (technical + marketer). Dropping into the Figma copy tab in 30m.
Patrick H: reminder: export filenames should use this pattern: bench_<variant>_<lang>_<size>.png — ops will automate uploads.
Maria G: All right — first pass Wed noon, will add comments for any brand inconsistencies.
Jess K: thanks team — if anything slips, we can cut a simplified hero and push localized overlays later. :thumbsup:
Anna R: Perfect. Closing action list: Anna = copy grid, Maria = hero+socials, Jess = tile layouts & exports, Patrick = routing + filenames, Marcus = legal/brand signoff. Back on Wed for review.
